_readme: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT. Only 3 of the 38 classes have entries below, purely to show the shape of the schema. Every field is a stand-in and must be replaced with text checked against a real agronomic source before submission (see android/README.md's ICAR-citation note). No entry may ever name a chemical or a dosage (CLAUDE.md rule 8) — 'management' stays generic (sanitation, resistant varieties, cultural practice) plus the KVK/extension-officer line, which the Result screen also always shows on its own regardless of what's in this file.
